I added `clever k8s nodegroups` with `create`, `list`, `get`, `update` and `delete`. `npm run fix-all` and `npm run validate` pass, but I haven't run the new commands against the API. Nothing is committed.

The API client functions and the `src/lib/k8s.js` helpers for node groups already existed, so the new files only define the commands. They are in `src/commands/k8s/` as `k8s.nodegroups.*.command.js`, plus `k8s.nodegroups.args.js` for the shared node group argument. The group is registered in `src/commands/global.commands.js`. It uses `since: null` and the existing `k8s` feature flag, like the other `k8s` commands.

| Command | Arguments | Options |
|---|---|---|
| `create` | cluster, node group name | `--flavor`, `--nodes`, `--description`, `--tag`, `--autoscaling`, `--min`, `--max`, `--org`, `--format` |
| `list` | cluster | `--org`, `--format` |
| `get` | cluster, node group | `--org`, `--format` |
| `update` | cluster, node group | `--nodes`, `--description`, `--tag`, `--autoscaling`, `--disable-autoscaling`, `--min`, `--max`, `--org`, `--format` |
| `delete` | cluster, node group | `--yes`, `--org` |

- **Node group argument:** it accepts an ID or a name. A name that matches several node groups is rejected with the matching IDs listed.
- **`update`:** it errors if you pass no change, or if `--min` is greater than `--max`. It also errors if `--autoscaling` comes without both `--min` and `--max`, or together with `--disable-autoscaling`.
- **`delete`:** it asks for confirmation unless you pass `--yes`.

`npm ci` failed to run `fix-all` and `validate` at first because dependencies weren't installed, so I installed them with `npm ci --ignore-scripts`. `fix-all` regenerated `k8s.docs.md` and `skills/clever-tools/references/full-documentation.md`, which should be committed with the change. It also reformatted `.claude/settings.json`, which I reverted.

I haven't updated `skills/clever-tools/SKILL.md`. I didn't check whether it mentions the `k8s` commands.
